subject: KNF status: repro complete, feedback-loop latency trade-off
body:
Hi Bao, Ximena,

Repro closed March 5, one day early. KNF beats our transformer and N-BEATS style baselines on M4-Weekly and on the Cryptos data, with the margin widening exactly where the paper says it should - on series flagged as suffering distribution shifts. Giannis's harness regenerates both datasets from scratch, no manual steps.

The trade-off we need to discuss: the feedback loop that continuously updates the learnt operators is what buys robustness under rapidly varying behavior, but in a serving context it means per-series state updates at inference time. Bilal's early benchmark puts it at ~9ms extra per forecast step, which is fine for daily batch forecasting but likely kills high-frequency use cases. We can offer a frozen-operator mode thats cheaper, but it gives back most of the shift robustness.

Recommendation: define the product tiers now (batch-robust vs low-latency) rather than promising both in one config. Happy to bring numbers to the April review.

Fumiko
